title: Is there a way to containerized a normal AWS Lambda function?
by: Stack Overflow question by Sivvie Lim
summary: A newcomer asks how to move an SNS-triggered Lambda function into a container on EKS. The answers, from October 2020, point to the `lambci/docker-lambda` images (since deprecated in favour of AWS’s official Lambda base images) and to Knative; read it mainly for the question, which is a common one, rather than for current tooling.
